mapper.select: select p.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, p.time_zone, p.sort_no, p.use_yn, p.row_ver from sys_plant p where p.use_yn = 'Y' order by p.sort_no, p.plant_cd
mapper.sql: left join aps_item_param p on p.plant_cd = m.plant_cd and p.item_id = m.item_id and p.use_yn = 'Y'

m.mps_item_id, m.plant_cd, m.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, trim_scale(coalesce(p.safety_qty, 0))::text as safety_qty, coalesce(p.lot_rule, 'EX') as lot_rule, trim_scale(p.lot_qty)::text as lot_qty, trim_scale(p.lot_mult)::text as lot_mult, m.remark, m.use_yn, m.row_ver, m.updated_at, m.updated_by
mapper.select: select item_id, item_cd, unit_cd, proc_type, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}

insert into aps_mps_item (comp_cd, plant_cd, item_id, remark, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{itemId}, #{remark}, #{useYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning mps_item_id
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}

select m.item_id, i.item_cd, i.unit_cd, coalesce(p.safety_qty, 0) as safety_qty, coalesce(p.lot_rule, 'EX') as lot_rule, p.lot_qty, p.lot_mult from aps_mps_item m join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id
where m.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and m.use_yn = 'Y' and i.use_yn = 'Y' order by i.item_cd
select m.mps_id, m.mps_no, m.plant_cd, m.horizon_start, m.horizon_days, m.status, m.row_ver from aps_mps m where m.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and m.status = 'FIRMED'

insert into aps_mps (comp_cd, mps_no, plant_cd, mps_nm, horizon_start, horizon_days, fence_days, fence_end, base_mps_id, item_cnt, calculated_by, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{m.mpsNo}, #{m.plantCd}, #{m.mpsNm}, #{m.horizonStart}, #{m.horizonDays}, #{m.fenceDays}, #{m.fenceEnd}, #{m.baseMpsId}, #{m.itemCnt}, #{by}, #{by}, #{by}) returning mps_id

insert into aps_mps_row (comp_cd, mps_id, item_id, unit_cd, stock_qty, safety_qty, lot_rule, lot_qty, lot_mult) values (hb_current_comp(), #{mpsId}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.unitCd}, #{r.stockQty}, #{r.safetyQty}, #{r.lotRule}, #{r.lotQty}, #{r.lotMult}) returning mps_row_id
mapper.insert:
insert into aps_mps_cell (comp_cd, mps_id, mps_row_id, bucket_date, demand_order, demand_fcst, past_due_qty, supply_wo, prop_qty, base_qty, fenced_yn, plan_qty) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{mpsId}, #{c.mpsRowId}, #{c.bucketDate}, #{c.demandOrder}, #{c.demandFcst}, #{c.pastDueQty}, #{c.supplyWo}, #{c.propQty}, #{c.baseQty}, #{c.fencedYn}, #{c.baseQty})
mapper.sql: m.mps_id, m.mps_no, m.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, m.mps_nm, m.horizon_start, m.horizon_days, m.fence_days, m.fence_end, m.base_mps_id, b.mps_no as base_mps_no, m.status, m.item_cnt, m.calculated_at, m.calculated_by, m.firmed_at, m.firmed_by, m.superseded_at, m.discard_reason, m.row_ver
mapper.select: select from aps_mps m join sys_plant p on p.plant_cd = m.plant_cd left join aps_mps b on b.mps_id = m.base_mps_id where m.mps_id = #{id}

select r.mps_row_id, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd, trim_scale(r.stock_qty)::text as stock_qty, trim_scale(r.safety_qty)::text as safety_qty, r.lot_rule, trim_scale(r.lot_qty)::text as lot_qty, trim_scale(r.lot_mult)::text as lot_mult from aps_mps_row r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id where r.mps_id = #{id} order by i.item_cd

select c.mps_cell_id, c.mps_row_id, c.bucket_date, trim_scale(c.demand_order)::text as demand_order, trim_scale(c.demand_fcst)::text as demand_fcst, trim_scale(c.past_due_qty)::text as past_due_qty, trim_scale(c.supply_wo)::text as supply_wo, trim_scale(c.prop_qty)::text as prop_qty, trim_scale(c.base_qty)::text as base_qty, c.fenced_yn, trim_scale(c.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, c.chg_reason from aps_mps_cell c where c.mps_id = #{id} order by c.mps_row_id, c.bucket_date
select status from aps_mps where mps_id = #{id} for update

select c.mps_cell_id, trim_scale(c.base_qty)::text as base_qty, c.fenced_yn, trim_scale(c.plan_qty)::text as plan_qty, c.chg_reason, r.unit_cd from aps_mps_cell c join aps_mps_row r on r.mps_row_id = c.mps_row_id where c.mps_id = #{mpsId} and c.mps_cell_id in #{id} order by c.mps_cell_id for update of c
mapper.update: update aps_mps_cell set plan_qty = #{planQty}, chg_reason = #{reason} where mps_cell_id = #{id}
update aps_mps set row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where mps_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
update aps_mps set status = 'SUPERSEDED', superseded_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where mps_id = #{id} and status = 'FIRMED'
update aps_mps set status = 'DISCARDED', discard_reason = #{reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where mps_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
